description: AFK+ settings version 2 (services/cloud-afk/README.md, 'AfkPlusConfig v2'). 'cases': a write ('input') with the account's context ('ctx': changes to the shared 'context') and its 'result': {ok: true, same: true} (stored exactly as written), {ok: true, config} (the document as stored: cleaned texts, a break that is over as null, finished orders and unshown custom items dropped, orders deleted during a trade kept) or {ok: false, status, code, …} (400 invalid_plus_config with field and reason, and problem for a text; 422 limit_rows {field, max}; 422 limit_orders {scope: active | stored, max}; 409 client_outdated; 413 payload_too_large); the first failing rule is the error. 'v1': a stored version 1 document and how it reads as version 2 (it is stored as it is when written back). 'defaults': a new account's settings with the context's profile open and with none. Generated by generate-afkplus-config-v2.mjs from hand-written expectations checked against afkplus-config.mjs; do not edit by hand.
